method: Actual generated giant near-base geometry; front-facing triangle centroids inside each camera frustum, weighted by projected area. Shader coverage model in CPU double precision. Primary barkSurface numbers exclude 3-D cushion meshes. Does not rasterize, resolve occlusion, wind, texture filtering or lighting; not a measured screen-pixel fraction.
maskAfter: mix(previousCover, min(previousCover, smoothstep(0.40, 0.84, vBarkMoss) * smoothstep(0.24, 0.58, mossFine)), barkNearDetail * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.96, 1.0, vBarkMoss)))
